name: Pagos OPC - Resumen
query:
SELECT
    opc.name                                   AS "OPC:Link/Orden de Pago Comisiones:220",
    opc.desde                                  AS "Desde:Date:110",
    opc.hasta_fecha                            AS "Hasta:Date:110",
    opc.confirmacion_de_pago                   AS "Estado:Data:140",
    COALESCE(opc.monto_total, 0)               AS "Total:Currency:140",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabComision LLCS` c WHERE c.parent = opc.name)
                                               AS "Filas:Int:80"
FROM `tabOrden de Pago Comisiones` opc
WHERE opc.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY opc.hasta_fecha DESC, opc.name DESC
LIMIT 200

name: Pagos OPC - Por Sucursal
query:
WITH detailed AS (
    SELECT
        si.cost_center                         AS cost_center,
        SUM(c.total_comision)                  AS total,
        COUNT(*)                               AS rows_cnt,
        c.parent                               AS opc_name
    FROM `tabComision LLCS` c
    INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = c.sales_invoice_id
    INNER JOIN `tabOrden de Pago Comisiones` opc ON opc.name = c.parent
    WHERE opc.docstatus = 1
    GROUP BY si.cost_center, c.parent
),
legacy AS (
    SELECT
        opc.sucursal                           AS cost_center,
        opc.monto_total                        AS total,
        1                                      AS rows_cnt,
        opc.name                               AS opc_name
    FROM `tabOrden de Pago Comisiones` opc
    WHERE opc.docstatus = 1
      AND opc.sucursal IS NOT NULL AND opc.sucursal != ''
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM `tabComision LLCS` c WHERE c.parent = opc.name
      )
)
SELECT
    x.cost_center                     AS `Sucursal (Cost Center)`,
    SUM(x.total)                      AS `Total Comisiones`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT x.opc_name)        AS `# OPCs`
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM detailed
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM legacy
) x
GROUP BY x.cost_center
ORDER BY x.cost_center;
